subject: Re: Redwood inference + LumenAI - marketplace & procurement path
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: LumenAI / Redwood - post-call: procurement & marketplace path

Hi Oliver - thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same view:

Recap:
- LumenAI is interested in Redwood for production inference (hosted API) and is evaluating procurement routes for an initial pilot (team-level) and potential enterprise expansion.
- Procurement preference: corporate billing via PO for enterprise; smaller internal teams may use card.
- Lumen is interested in marketplace procurement (AWS first) to simplify billing if we can list there.

Open questions / actions:
1) Which procurement path should we prepare for first: direct PO (Redwood MSA + SOW) or AWS Marketplace subscription?
2) Who is the procurement contact we should engage to complete vendor onboarding and the vendor form?
3) Any specific invoicing terms (net-30, remit-to, tax ID) we should include up front?

Proposed next steps:
- If PO path: I can share our standard MSA + SOW and the Redwood vendor onboarding packet for your procurement team to review.
- If Marketplace preferred: I'll loop in our marketplace ops teammate and share the marketplace onboarding checklist + timeline (typically 2-4 weeks after listing approval).

I've cc'd Marissa (solutions) and Jonas (sales lead) so we can answer technical and procurement questions quickly.

Thanks - happy to jump on a quick follow-up with procurement if that helps.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

Hi Camila - appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from our side:

- For the pilot (small team), we will likely use a corporate card. For enterprise procurement we require a PO and vendor onboarding.
- We prefer AWS Marketplace if Redwood is available there - it speeds procurement and aligns with our internal purchasing flow.
- I've cc'd Catherine (our procurement lead) and Sanjay (cloud infra) who will own vendor onboarding and marketplace checks.

Catherine, can you confirm the vendor documents you need? We typically need a W-9 (US), vendor registration form, and our legal team will review a standard MSA. If Redwood supports net-30 terms and electronic invoicing, that would be ideal.

Timeline: if we go PO path expect ~4-6 weeks (legal + approvals). Marketplace subscription could be completed in ~1-2 weeks once the listing is live.

Thanks,
Oliver
Director of Product | LumenAI
oliver@lumenai.com

Thanks Oliver - helpful. Catherine/Sanjay - welcome. To make this easy, here are two concrete paths and what we'll need from Lumen to move forward:

Option A - Direct PO (recommended for enterprise):
- What we provide: Redwood MSA + SOW with the pilot scope, Electronic Invoicing, standard net-30 (can negotiate). We'll provide an invoice schedule tied to milestone or monthly usage.
- What we need from you: Completed vendor onboarding form, PO referencing deal id LUM-2345, billing remit-to details, and W-9 (US).
- Typical timeline: 4-6 weeks (legal review + procurement).

Option B - AWS Marketplace (recommended to speed procurement):
- What we provide: Marketplace listing and subscription flow; billing goes through AWS, Lumen completes subscription in Marketplace, time-to-usage typically 1-2 weeks after listing activation.
- What we need from you: Confirmation you'll accept Marketplace invoices through AWS; minimal vendor paperwork on your side. Our marketplace ops team will handle the listing side.

Attachments I'm sending now: redwood-sla-2026.pdf (SLA summary) and marketplace-onboarding-checklist.pdf. I'll also drop a DocuSign link if you'd prefer to sign the MSA electronically.

Questions for procurement to confirm:
- Do you require any special tax/GST fields on invoices?
- Is net-30 acceptable or do you require a different term?

If you're comfortable, I can open the vendor onboarding ticket and share the formal vendor packet. Happy to schedule a 30-min meet with procurement this week to walk through items.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Camila / Oliver - thanks for the detail. I'm LumenAI procurement - I'll own vendor onboarding. Please see attached vendor onboarding form. A few clarifying items:

- We require a completed vendor onboarding form (attached), W-9 for US vendors, and a sample invoice showing remit-to.
- Standard terms: net-30 is acceptable. We do collect tax ID/EIN and remit address.
- For marketplace purchases via AWS: we still do a light vendor registration, but the subscription and billing is handled by AWS which reduces internal approvals.

Can you confirm Redwood's billing contact, tax ID/EIN, and whether you can accept PO LUM-2345 for the initial pilot? Also please confirm whether Redwood supports electronic invoices (PDF via procurements@lumenai.com).

I've attached the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf - please return the completed form and W-9.

Thanks,

Hi Oliver - quick technical notes to address a couple procurement questions Sanjay raised on the call:

- Usage reporting & invoicing: We provide monthly usage reports and a token/compute breakdown per API key. If you prefer invoice line items mapped to project tags, we can include that in the SOW.
- SLA & support: Our standard hosted SLA is summarized in the attached redwood-sla-2026.pdf. For pilot customers on marketplace, support is via standard support channel; for enterprise we can include a named-response SLA in the SOW.
- Marketplace vs direct: No change to the API or billing metrics - marketplace simply routes billing through AWS; usage reporting comes from Redwood.

If you'd like, I can prepare a short appendix for the SOW that enumerates reporting fields and contact points for billing reconciliation.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
